note: Pure jq field references (.a.b / ${ .a.b }) are lowered to JSONPath so the sound SC1101/SC1110 checks fire at declared record boundaries (input/output schemas). A comparison or presence guard over a document field (.a.b == v, .a.b < v, .a.b != null, and the leading operand of a short-circuiting and/or) likewise lowers to that field's read; the remaining composite jq (pipes, arithmetic, object construction, $context/$workflow runtime references) projects to Top and stays soundly silent. The 18/12 counts are value-position pure field-reference sites and are unchanged by the guard-operator extension (the corpus's when guards are all equality; its non-equality comparisons sit under if/while/filter/data).
